arxiv-1810-08802.title: Hierarchical Text Generation using an Outline
arxiv-1810-08802.creator: Mehdi Drissi, Olivia Watkins, Jugal Kalita
arxiv-1810-08802.description: Abstract Many challenges in natural language processing require generating text, including language translation, dialogue generation, and speech recognition. For all of these problems, text generation becomes more difficult as the text becomes longer. Current language models often struggle to keep track of coherence for long pieces of text.

arxiv-2204-01975.title: GAIL-PT: A Generic Intelligent Penetration Testing Framework with Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning
arxiv-2204-01975.creator: Jinyin Chen, Shulong Hu, Haibin Zheng, Changyou Xing, Guomin Zhang
arxiv-2204-01975.description: Abstract Penetration testing (PT) is an efficient network testing and vulnerability mining tool by simulating a hacker’s attack for valuable information applied in some areas, e.g., the host’s operating and database systems. Compared with manual PT, intelligent PT has become a dominating mainstream due to less time-consuming and lower labor costs.

arxiv-2410-08670.title: Mahi-Mahi : Low-Latency Asynchronous BFT DAG-Based Consensus
arxiv-2410-08670.creator: Philipp Jovanovic, Lefteris Kokoris-Kogias, Bryan Kumara, Alberto Sonnino, Pasindu Tennage, Igor Zablotchi
arxiv-2410-08670.description: Abstract We present Mahi-Mahi , the first asynchronous BFT consensus protocol that achieves sub-second latency in a WAN setting while processing over 100,000 transactions per second. Mahi-Mahi achieves such high performance by leveraging an uncertified structured Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to forgo explicit certification.

arxiv-2505-00228.title: ReXGradient-160K: A Large-Scale Publicly Available Dataset of Chest Radiographs with Free-text Reports
arxiv-2505-00228.creator: Xiaoman Zhang, Julián N. Acosta, Josh Miller, Ouwen Huang, Pranav Rajpurkar 🖂
arxiv-2505-00228.description: Abstract We present ReXGradient-160K, representing the largest publicly available chest X-ray dataset to date in terms of the number of patients. This dataset contains 160,000 chest X-ray studies with paired radiological reports from 109,487 unique patients across 3 U.S. health systems (79 medical sites).

arxiv-2507-22608.title: Language Arithmetics: Towards Systematic Language Neuron Identification and Manipulation
arxiv-2507-22608.creator: Daniil Gurgurov Katharina Trinley Yusser Al Ghussin, Tanja Bäumel Josef van Genabith Simon Ostermann
arxiv-2507-22608.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong multilingual abilities, yet the neural mechanisms behind language-specific processing remain unclear. We analyze language-specific neurons in Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, and Aya-Expanse-8B & 32B across 21 typologically diverse languages , identifying neurons that control language behavior.

pmc-10647708.title: Judd–Ofelt Analysis and Spectroscopy Study of Tellurite Glasses Doped with Rare-Earth (Nd3+, Sm3+, Dy3+, and Er3+)
pmc-10647708.creator: Naziha Boudchicha, Mostepha Iezid, Faycal Goumeidane, Messaoud Legouera, P Syam Prasad, P Venkateswara Rao, El Sayed Yousef, Manuela Joanna Reben
pmc-10647708.description: A series of glasses based on (80-y) TeO2-20 BiCl3-y RE2O3 (y = 0, 0.6 mol%; RE = Nd, Sm, Dy, and Er) were prepared. The thermal stability of the glass was determined by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC). The density and optical energy values of the prepared glass increased in the order of Sm2O3, Nd2O3, Dy2O3, and Er2O3.

pmc-11573725.title: A Comparative Study of the Perspectives of Long‐Stay Immigrants, Nurses and Cultural Mediators on Intercultural Communication: A Secondary Qualitative Analysis
pmc-11573725.creator: Francesc Ramos‐Roure, Maria Feijoo‐Cid, Josep Maria Manresa‐Dominguez, Jordi Segura‐Bernal, Rosa García‐Sierra, Maria Isabel Fernández‐Cano, Antonia Arreciado Marañón, Eduard Moreno‐Gabriel, Clara Flamarich Gol, Pere Toran‐Monserrat

pmc-11682715.title: Identification and characterization of a Relish-type NF-κB, DvRelish, in Dermacentor variabilis in response to Rickettsia rickettsii infection
pmc-11682715.creator: Chanida Fongsaran, Victoria I. Verhoeve, Krit Jirakanwisal, Emma K. Harris, Kevin R. Macaluso
pmc-11682715.description: Ixodid ticks serve as hosts and transmission vectors for several obligate intracellular bacteria, including members of the spotted fever group (SFG) of Rickettsia. Although ticks generate an immune response to bacterial insults, many of the signaling molecules associated with the response and how they may contribute to vector competence for Rickettsia are undefined.

pmc-12093613.title: Clinical practice guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of scabies in Korea: Part 2. Treatment and prevention — a secondary publication
pmc-12093613.creator: Jin Park, Soon-Hyo Kwon, Young Bok Lee, Hei Sung Kim, Jie Hyun Jeon, Gwang Seong Choi
pmc-12093613.description: Treatment should be initiated for all suspected, clinical, or confirmed cases of scabies. Patients affected should be adequately isolated, and high-risk groups with close contact histories should be treated regardless of their symptoms. Optimal treatment strategies can be selected based on age, clinical subtype, and the patient's health status.

pmc-13096765.title: Novel Influence Diagnostics in Multistate Models for Breast Cancer
pmc-13096765.creator: Valeria Leiva‐Yamaguchi, Alejandra Tapia, Manuel Galea, Oscar M. Rueda
pmc-13096765.description: Multistate models were developed to model survival data where several midpoints and endpoints are of interest; and they have been particular successful in modeling dynamics of cancer. As in any statistical model, identification of influential observations is an essential task, as they can significantly affect the validity of inferred parameters and conclusions drawn from the data.

pmc-13442917.title: Synchronous Tumor of Colorectal Adenocarcinoma and Epstein‐Barr Virus‐Positive Diffuse Large B‐Cell Lymphoma: A Case Report
pmc-13442917.creator: Fen Liu, Linlin Fan, Hong Yu, Zhiyong Wei
pmc-13442917.description: The third reported case of synchronous colorectal adenocarcinoma and EBV‐positive DLBCL in an 87‐year‐old patient confirms the rarity of this synchronous tumor. Despite segmental resection, the patient died from postoperative complications, highlighting the need for multidisciplinary research into pathogenesis and management.

pmc-13503359.title: Influenza vaccine uptake among healthcare workers in GCC countries: a narrative review of enablers and barriers
pmc-13503359.creator: Syed Abid Ali, Silvija Ille, Jayakumary Muttappallymyalil, Jayadevan Sreedharan, Mehzabin Ahmed
pmc-13503359.description: IntroductionInfluenza is a contagious viral infection and a significant seasonal threat to public health. Vaccinating healthcare workers (HCWs) is a critical strategy for protecting vulnerable patients and the healthcare workforce. In the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, vaccine uptake is <75%, despite the healthcare promotion initiatives and free vaccination campaigns.
